learn.h:
🧩 Classifying Matter物质的分类

Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子

OX2​, COX2​, NaCl, Fe, SOX4​X2− — the test gives you a list of formulas and asks: atom, element, molecule, compound or ion? Some get two labels. Four quick questions sort every one.OX2​、COX2​、NaCl、Fe、SOX4​X2−——考试给一串化学式，问：原子、元素、分子、化合物还是离子？有的要写两个标签。四个小问题就能全部分清。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  1. Charge → ion. Lone symbol / "one particle" → atom.有电荷→离子。单个符号／「一个粒子」→原子。
  2. 2+ atoms, one type → molecule + element (OX2​). 2+ types → molecule + compound (HX2​O).2 个以上原子、一种→分子＋元素（OX2​）。两种以上→分子＋化合物（HX2​O）。
  3. Element = one TYPE of atom, not one atom. Class key: NaCl → compound only.元素＝一「种」原子，不是一个原子。讲义答案：NaCl 只是化合物。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  • Which label?贴哪个标签？
    • Charge shown (+ / −)有电荷（＋／－）
      • Ion (I)离子（I）NO3−, SO4 2−NO3−、SO4 2−
    • One particle / single symbol一个粒子／单个符号
      • Atom (A)原子（A）Fe, Cl, one copper particleFe、Cl、一个铜粒子
    • 2+ atoms, one type2 个以上原子，同一种
      • Molecule + Element (M, E)分子＋元素（M、E）O2, F2O2、F2
    • 2+ atoms, different types2 个以上原子，不同种
      • Molecule + Compound (M, C)分子＋化合物（M、C）H2O, CO2, NH3, CH4H2O、CO2、NH3、CH4
      • NaCl → Compound (C) onlyNaCl → 只标化合物（C）

🧗 The hard part难点 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子

Giving one or two labels贴一个还是两个标签

The same formula can be a molecule AND an element/compound, and students stop after one.同一个化学式可以既是分子又是元素／化合物，学生常写一个就停。

  1. Charged? → I only.带电？→只写 I。
  2. Single symbol? → A only.单个符号？→只写 A。
  3. Bonded atoms? → M, then add E (one type) or C (different types). NaCl-type → C.原子成键？→写 M，再加 E（一种）或 C（不同种）。NaCl 类→C。
Try试一试
Label CHX4​, FX2​, Cl.标注 CHX4​、FX2​、Cl。
Answer答案
CHX4​: M, C · FX2​: E, M · Cl: ACHX4​：M、C · FX2​：E、M · Cl：A

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  • OX2​ has 2 atoms so not an element → one type = element (and molecule).OX2​ 有 2 个原子所以不是元素 → 一种原子＝元素（也是分子）。
  • SOX4​X2− is a compound → the charge makes it an ion.SOX4​X2− 是化合物 → 有电荷，是离子。
🟡
Your class answer key labels a lone symbol like Fe or Cl as an atom, labels O2 and F2 as both molecule and element, and labels NaCl as a compound only. Many textbooks would say Fe can also mean the element iron, and that NaCl is an ionic compound made of ions, not molecules — which is why NaCl gets only "C" even though the class notes box says "all compounds are molecules". On this test use the class labels.课堂答案把 Fe、Cl 这样的单个符号标为原子，把 O2、F2 标为分子兼元素，把 NaCl 只标为化合物。很多教材会说 Fe 也可以指铁这种元素，而 NaCl 是由离子构成的离子化合物、不是分子——这也是为什么讲义方框写着「所有化合物都是分子」，NaCl 却只标「C」。考试按讲义的标签答。
🎯
Ask in order: charge? one particle? how many types?依次问：有电荷？单个粒子？几种原子？

🧩 Classifying Matter物质的分类

Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液

Salt water, trail mix, copper, sugar, air — every one lands in exactly one box of the classification tree. Learn the two questions that walk you down the tree and this whole section is marks.盐水、什锦坚果、铜、糖、空气——每一样都正好落在分类树的一个格子里。学会沿着树往下走的两个问题，这一整节就是送分。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  1. Homogeneous = 1 phase; heterogeneous = more than 1 phase = mechanical mixture.均匀＝1 个相；不均匀＝不止 1 个相＝机械混合物。
  2. Homogeneous splits: pure substance (constant composition) vs solution (variable composition).均匀物质再分：纯净物（组成固定）与溶液（组成可变）。
  3. Pure splits: element (1 type of atom) vs compound (more than 1). Solute dissolves in solvent.纯净物再分：元素（1 种原子）与化合物（不止 1 种）。溶质溶于溶剂。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  • ALL SUBSTANCES所有物质
    • HOMOGENEOUS SUBSTANCES均匀物质only one phase只有一个相
      • PURE SUBSTANCES纯净物constant composition组成固定
        • ELEMENT元素（单质）1 type of atom present只有 1 种原子
        • COMPOUND化合物more than 1 type of atom present不止 1 种原子
      • HOMOGENEOUS MIXTURES均匀混合物variable composition组成可变
        • SOLUTION溶液
    • HETEROGENEOUS SUBSTANCES不均匀物质more than one phase不止一个相
      • MECHANICAL MIXTURES机械混合物variable composition组成可变

🧗 The hard part难点 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液

Pure substance vs solution纯净物与溶液

Both are one phase and look identical.两者都是一个相，看起来一模一样。

  1. Does it have one fixed formula? → pure.有单一固定化学式吗？→纯净物。
  2. Can the amounts change (more or less salty/sweet)? → solution.比例能变吗（更咸／更甜）？→溶液。
  3. Evidence: evaporating a solution leaves the solute behind.证据：溶液蒸干后会留下溶质。
Try试一试
Pure substance or solution: (a) apple juice (b) HX2​OX2​ (pure hydrogen peroxide)纯净物还是溶液：(a) 苹果汁 (b) HX2​OX2​（纯过氧化氢）
Answer答案
(a) solution (b) pure substance (compound)(a) 溶液 (b) 纯净物（化合物）

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  • Clear liquid = pure → could be a solution (salt water).澄清液体＝纯净物 → 也可能是溶液（盐水）。
  • Compound = mixture (has 2 elements) → compound is pure (fixed formula).化合物＝混合物（含两种元素）→ 化合物是纯净物（化学式固定）。
🟡
Your class notes list soil as a homogeneous mixture. Most textbooks call soil heterogeneous (a mechanical mixture), because you can usually see bits of sand, clay and plant matter. On this test, if soil is asked, use the class answer: homogeneous mixture.课堂讲义把土壤列为均匀混合物。多数教材把土壤归为不均匀混合物（机械混合物），因为通常能看到沙粒、黏土和植物残渣。考试如果问到土壤，按讲义答：均匀混合物。
🎯
Three questions in order: phases? fixed composition? types of atom?按顺序三问：几个相？组成固定？几种原子？

quiz.q: Term: the smallest particle of an element that still has the properties of that element.术语：仍保持元素性质的最小粒子。
quiz.a: Atom原子
quiz.sol: • The smallest piece that is still gold is one gold atom → atom.仍是金的最小一块就是一个金原子→原子。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of atom.回忆原子的定义。
quiz.idea: Cut gold until you cannot cut any more → one atom.把金一直切到不能再切→一个原子。

quiz.q: Name the three main subatomic particles in an atom.说出原子中的三种主要亚原子粒子。
quiz.a: Protons, neutrons, electrons质子、中子、电子
quiz.sol: • Atoms are made of protons, neutrons and electrons.原子由质子、中子和电子构成。
quiz.goal: Recall what atoms are made of.回忆原子由什么构成。
quiz.idea: p, n, e.p、n、e。

quiz.q: Classify CaX2+.给 CaX2+ 分类。
quiz.a: Ion (I)离子（I）
quiz.sol: • 2+ charge → ion.带 2+ 电荷→离子。
quiz.goal: Recognise an ion by its charge.凭电荷认出离子。
quiz.idea: A charge is shown → ion.有电荷→离子。

quiz.q: Which labels fit ClX2​?ClX2​ 应贴哪些标签？
c: Atom only只是原子
Molecule and element分子和元素
Molecule and compound分子和化合物
Ion离子
quiz.a: Molecule and element分子和元素
quiz.sol: • 2 atoms bonded → molecule; only chlorine → element.2 个原子成键→分子；只有氯→元素。
quiz.goal: Classify a diatomic element.给双原子元素分类。
quiz.idea: Two atoms bonded, one type → M, E (like FX2​).两个原子成键、同一种→M、E（同 FX2​）。

quiz.q: Which labels fit CX6​HX12​OX6​ (glucose)?CX6​HX12​OX6​（葡萄糖）应贴哪些标签？
c: Element only只是元素
Molecule and element分子和元素
Ion离子
Molecule and compound分子和化合物
quiz.a: Molecule and compound分子和化合物
quiz.sol: • C, H, O → 3 different types bonded together → molecule and compound.C、H、O→3 种不同原子结合→分子和化合物。
quiz.goal: Classify a covalent compound.给共价化合物分类。
quiz.idea: Three types of atom bonded, no charge → M, C (like sugar CX12​HX22​OX11​).三种原子成键、无电荷→M、C（同蔗糖 CX12​HX22​OX11​）。

quiz.q: Classify each with the class letters: (a) Ag (b) HX2​OX2​ (c) POX4​X3− (d) SX8​用讲义字母分类：(a) Ag (b) HX2​OX2​ (c) POX4​X3− (d) SX8​
quiz.a: (a) A (b) M, C (c) I (d) M, E(a) A (b) M、C (c) I (d) M、E
quiz.sol:
• (a) Single symbol, no subscript → A (class: Fe → A).(a) 单个符号、无下标→A（讲义：Fe→A）。
  • (b) H and O bonded → M, C.(b) H 与 O 成键→M、C。
  • (c) 3− charge → I.(c) 带 3− 电荷→I。
  • (d) 8 sulfur atoms, one type → M, E.(d) 8 个硫原子、同一种→M、E。
quiz.goal: Classify unfamiliar formulas with the four-question method.用四问法给陌生化学式分类。
quiz.idea: Charge → I; lone symbol → A; one type → M,E; different types → M,C.有电荷→I；单个符号→A；一种原子→M、E；不同种→M、C。

quiz.q: Is every molecule a compound? Use NX2​ and NHX3​ to explain.所有分子都是化合物吗？用 NX2​ 和 NHX3​ 解释。
quiz.a: No. NX2​ is a molecule (2 bonded atoms) but only one type of atom, so it is an element, not a compound. NHX3​ has two types, so it is both a molecule and a compound.不是。NX2​ 是分子（2 个原子成键），但只有一种原子，所以是元素而不是化合物。NHX3​ 有两种原子，所以既是分子又是化合物。
quiz.sol:
• NX2​: molecule + element.NX2​：分子＋元素。
  • NHX3​: molecule + compound. So only some molecules are compounds.NHX3​：分子＋化合物。所以只有部分分子是化合物。
quiz.goal: Compare the molecule and compound definitions with examples.用例子比较分子和化合物的定义。
quiz.idea: A molecule can be made of one type of atom; a compound cannot.分子可以只含一种原子；化合物不可以。

quiz.q: Ozone (OX3​) and oxygen gas (OX2​) are both made only of oxygen. A classmate says ozone must be a compound because it has 3 atoms and behaves differently from OX2​. Classify OX3​ and justify.臭氧（OX3​）和氧气（OX2​）都只由氧构成。同学说臭氧有 3 个原子、性质又和 OX2​ 不同，所以一定是化合物。给 OX3​ 分类并说明理由。
quiz.a: OX3​ is a molecule and an element (M, E). It has only one type of atom; a compound needs 2+ different types. The number of atoms and its different behaviour do not make it a compound.OX3​ 是分子和元素（M、E）。它只有一种原子；化合物需要 2 种以上不同原子。原子个数和性质不同都不能使它成为化合物。
quiz.sol:
• Types of atom in OX3​: only O → element.OX3​ 中的原子种类：只有 O→元素。
  • 3 atoms bonded → molecule.3 个原子成键→分子。
  • Compound requires different types; atom count and properties are irrelevant.化合物要求不同种原子；原子个数和性质无关。
quiz.goal: Apply the definitions to an unfamiliar substance and reject a tempting wrong argument.把定义用于陌生物质，并驳倒一个看似合理的错误论证。
quiz.idea: Classification depends on the types of atom, not on the number of atoms or how it behaves.分类看原子种类，不看原子个数，也不看性质表现。

quiz.q: A homogeneous mixture is also called a ___.均匀混合物又叫作 ___。
quiz.a: Solution溶液
quiz.sol: • Homogeneous mixture = solution.均匀混合物＝溶液。
quiz.goal: Recall that homogeneous mixtures are solutions.记住均匀混合物就是溶液。
quiz.idea: All mixtures are either mechanical or solutions.所有混合物要么是机械混合物，要么是溶液。

quiz.q: In sugar water, which substance is the solute?糖水中，哪种物质是溶质？
quiz.sol: • Sugar dissolves into the water → sugar is the solute, water is the solvent.糖溶进水里→糖是溶质，水是溶剂。
quiz.goal: Recall the meaning of solute.回忆溶质的含义。
quiz.idea: The solute is the one that gets dissolved.溶质是被溶解的那一种。

quiz.q: Classify distilled water (HX2​O): element, compound, solution or mechanical mixture?给蒸馏水（HX2​O）分类：元素、化合物、溶液还是机械混合物？
quiz.a: Compound (pure substance)化合物（纯净物）
quiz.sol: • Distilled water is only HX2​O → pure substance; H and O → compound.蒸馏水只含 HX2​O→纯净物；含 H 和 O→化合物。
quiz.goal: Place a familiar pure compound on the tree.把熟悉的纯化合物放到分类树上。
quiz.idea: Fixed formula with two types of atom.化学式固定，含两种原子。

quiz.q: Classify muddy pond water in which you can see bits of dirt floating.给能看到泥土颗粒漂浮的浑浊池塘水分类。
quiz.a: Mechanical (heterogeneous) mixture机械混合物（不均匀混合物）
quiz.sol: • You can see dirt and water → more than one phase → mechanical mixture.能看见泥和水→不止一个相→机械混合物。
quiz.goal: Recognise a heterogeneous mixture.认出不均匀混合物。
quiz.idea: Visible bits → more than one phase.看得见颗粒→不止一个相。

quiz.q: Which one is a solution?哪一个是溶液？
c: Copper wire铜线
Brass (copper and zinc evenly melted together)黄铜（铜和锌均匀熔合）
A salad沙拉
Table salt, NaCl食盐 NaCl
quiz.a: Brass黄铜
quiz.sol:
• Copper: element. NaCl: compound. Salad: mechanical mixture.铜：元素。NaCl：化合物。沙拉：机械混合物。
  • Brass: two metals evenly mixed, one phase, variable amounts → solution.黄铜：两种金属均匀混合、一个相、比例可变→溶液。
quiz.goal: Pick the homogeneous mixture from a list.从选项中挑出均匀混合物。
quiz.idea: A solution has 2+ substances and looks uniform; it does not have to be a liquid.溶液含 2 种以上物质且看起来均匀；不一定是液体。

quiz.q: Classify each and give the path down the tree: (a) seawater (b) oxygen gas OX2​ (c) concrete with visible stones (d) baking soda NaHCOX3​给每样分类并写出沿树往下的路径：(a) 海水 (b) 氧气 OX2​ (c) 能看见石子的混凝土 (d) 小苏打 NaHCOX3​
quiz.a: (a) homogeneous → mixture → solution (b) homogeneous → pure → element (c) heterogeneous → mechanical mixture (d) homogeneous → pure → compound(a) 均匀→混合物→溶液 (b) 均匀→纯净物→元素 (c) 不均匀→机械混合物 (d) 均匀→纯净物→化合物
quiz.sol:
• (a) Salts dissolved in water, uniform, saltiness varies → solution.(a) 盐类溶于水、均匀、咸度可变→溶液。
  • (b) Only O atoms → element. (d) Na, H, C, O in a fixed formula → compound.(b) 只有 O 原子→元素。(d) Na、H、C、O 按固定化学式结合→化合物。
  • (c) Stones visible → more than one phase → mechanical mixture.(c) 看得见石子→不止一个相→机械混合物。
quiz.goal: Use the full tree with reasons at each branch.用完整的分类树，并在每个分支给出理由。
quiz.idea: Phases first, then fixed or variable, then types of atom.先看相数，再看组成固定还是可变，最后看原子种类。

quiz.q: According to your class notes, soil is classified as:按课堂讲义，土壤属于：
c: An element元素
A compound化合物
A homogeneous mixture均匀混合物
A pure substance纯净物
quiz.a: A homogeneous mixture (class version)均匀混合物（讲义说法）
quiz.sol:
• Soil has many substances in varying amounts → a mixture, not pure.土壤含多种比例不定的物质→混合物，不是纯净物。
  • The class notes list it under homogeneous mixtures (many textbooks say heterogeneous — use the class answer on this test).讲义把它列在均匀混合物下（很多教材说不均匀——这次考试按讲义答）。
quiz.goal: Recall a class classification that differs from many textbooks.记住一个与很多教材不同的讲义分类。
quiz.idea: Soil is certainly a mixture (many substances, variable); the class lists it as homogeneous.土壤肯定是混合物（多种物质、比例可变）；讲义把它列为均匀的。

quiz.q: A student is given an unknown clear, colourless liquid. When a sample is heated until all the liquid is gone, a white solid is left in the dish. Is the liquid a pure substance or a solution? Explain using the classification tree.学生拿到一种未知的澄清无色液体。取样加热到液体全部蒸干后，碟子里留下白色固体。这种液体是纯净物还是溶液？用分类树说明。
quiz.a: A solution. It is one phase (clear, uniform), so it is homogeneous — but heating left a white solid, so it contained at least two substances: a dissolved solid (solute) in a liquid (solvent). Two substances with variable amounts = homogeneous mixture = solution.溶液。它是一个相（澄清均匀），所以是均匀物质——但加热后留下白色固体，说明它至少含两种物质：溶解的固体（溶质）和液体（溶剂）。两种物质、比例可变＝均匀混合物＝溶液。
quiz.sol:
• Clear and uniform → one phase → homogeneous (pure substance OR solution).澄清均匀→一个相→均匀物质（纯净物或溶液）。
  • A pure liquid would leave nothing behind. A white solid remained → a dissolved solute was present.纯液体蒸干后什么也不会留下。留下了白色固体→其中溶有溶质。
  • Two substances → mixture → solution.两种物质→混合物→溶液。
quiz.goal: Use lab evidence to decide between a pure substance and a solution.用实验证据判断纯净物还是溶液。
quiz.idea: Looking clear only proves "homogeneous". The leftover solid shows a second substance was dissolved.看起来澄清只能证明「均匀」。残留固体说明还溶有第二种物质。

diag.q: Which labels fit COX2​?COX2​ 应贴哪些标签？
c: Element and molecule元素和分子
Compound only, because it has 3 atoms只是化合物，因为有 3 个原子
Ion离子
Molecule and compound分子和化合物
why: Element needs one type of atom; COX2​ has two (C and O).元素只能有一种原子；COX2​ 有两种（C 和 O）。
Forgets that bonded atoms also make it a molecule; the class key gives two labels.忘了原子成键也使它成为分子；讲义答案是两个标签。
No charge is shown, so it is not an ion.没有电荷，不是离子。
Correct: bonded atoms of two different types → M, C.正确：两种不同原子成键→M、C。
diag.goal: Give both labels to a covalent compound.给共价化合物贴两个标签。
diag.idea: Bonded → M; different types → C.成键→M；不同种→C。

diag.q: A sample of pure copper wire contains billions of copper atoms. What is the wire?一段纯铜线含有数十亿个铜原子。这段铜线是什么？
c: A compound, because it has many atoms化合物，因为原子很多
An element, because there is only one type of atom元素，因为只有一种原子
An ion, because metals have charges离子，因为金属带电荷
Not an element, because an element is one atom不是元素，因为元素只有一个原子
why: Compounds need different types of atom; the number of atoms does not matter.化合物需要不同种原子；原子多少无关。
Correct: one TYPE of atom (copper) → element, no matter how many atoms.正确：只有一「种」原子（铜）→元素，不管有多少个。
A copper wire carries no overall charge; no + or − is shown.铜线整体不带电，也没有标出 ＋ 或 －。
Classic mix-up: one type of atom does not mean one atom.经典误区：一种原子不等于一个原子。
diag.goal: Apply "one type, not one atom" to a real object.把「一种而非一个」用到真实物体上。
diag.idea: Like the 10 g gold piece in the notes.同讲义里 10 g 金块的例子。

diag.q: Trail mix (nuts, raisins, chocolate) is a:什锦坚果（坚果、葡萄干、巧克力）是：
c: Solution溶液
Compound化合物
Mechanical mixture机械混合物
Pure substance纯净物
why: A solution looks the same everywhere; you can see separate pieces here.溶液处处一样；这里能看到分开的块。
A compound is a pure substance with a fixed formula; trail mix has none.化合物是有固定化学式的纯净物；什锦坚果没有。
Correct: visible different parts → heterogeneous → mechanical mixture.正确：看得见不同部分→不均匀→机械混合物。
Many substances in variable amounts — not pure.含多种比例不定的物质——不是纯净物。
diag.goal: Classify a familiar heterogeneous mixture.给熟悉的不均匀混合物分类。
diag.idea: Visible parts → more than one phase.看得见不同部分→不止一个相。

diag.q: Air is a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen and other gases, yet it looks the same everywhere. Where does air go on the tree?空气是氮气、氧气和其他气体的混合物，但处处看起来一样。空气在分类树的哪里？
c: Pure substance, because it is uniform纯净物，因为它均匀
Solution (homogeneous mixture)溶液（均匀混合物）
Mechanical mixture, because it has several gases机械混合物，因为含多种气体
Element, because it is a gas元素，因为它是气体
why: Uniform only means homogeneous; air has several substances, so it is not pure.均匀只说明是均匀物质；空气含多种物质，不是纯净物。
Correct: one phase + several substances in variable amounts → solution.正确：一个相＋多种比例可变的物质→溶液。
Several substances does not mean heterogeneous — gases mix into one phase.多种物质不等于不均匀——气体会混成一个相。
Being a gas says nothing about the types of atom; air has several elements and compounds.是气体与原子种类无关；空气含多种元素和化合物。
diag.goal: Combine "gases form one phase" with the pure-vs-mixture split.把「气体为一个相」与纯净物／混合物的划分结合。
diag.idea: One phase AND more than one substance → solution.一个相且不止一种物质→溶液。
